description: A sleek, minimalist kitchen photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens in a one-point perspective composition looking down the length of the galley between the island and the appliance wall. The camera is positioned at the near end of the kitchen corridor, creating strong vanishing-point perspective leading to an open doorway in the background. On the left, a long white lacquer island with a matte white quartz countertop features an induction cooktop and undermount sink with a brushed nickel gooseneck faucet. A folded magazine sits on the island counter. A minimal black-framed door opening in the far white wall leads to an adjacent passageway. The floor is large-format ivory travertine. The palette is very stark — pure white walls and ceiling, white island, deep espresso wood, and stainless steel. The atmosphere is precision-crafted and almost gallery-like in its restraint.
